about.p2_desc: Google Play Console & Apple App Store Connect pipeline orchestration. End-to-end management from policy compliance and certificate signing to staged rollout and crash telemetry.
about.p3_desc: Refactoring monolithic, legacy codebases to conform to current target SDK standards. Direct integration of payment gateways, barcode/sensor systems, and commercial IoT logic.

projects.title: Featured Engineering Projects
projects.desc: High-performance production architectures, smart wearable health systems, and computer vision access systems.

p1.title: Health Record & Diabetes Risk Analysis App
p1.desc: Comprehensive patient health monitoring ecosystem equipped with predictive risk calculation algorithms and real-time biometric capture.
p1.f1: Heart rate measurement powered by smartphone camera PPG technology and optical frame analysis.
p1.f2: Health parameter tracking and automated diabetes risk prediction algorithm for early diagnosis.
p1.f3: Interactive historical health logs with dynamic trend visualization and metric charts.
p1.f4: Personalized health recommendations based on patient age, lifestyle inputs, and BMI metrics.

p2.title: Wear OS Abnormal Vital Detection & Alert System
p2.desc: Emergency assistance wearable system designed to monitor elderly or high-risk patients, instantly routing life-saving telemetry to guardians.
p2.f1: Real-time heart rate and continuous background step counter monitoring without battery drain.
p2.f2: Automated fall detection sensor trigger with 15-second emergency SOS cancellation prompt.
p2.f3: Instant alert dispatching directly integrated with LINE messaging app via webhooks.
p2.f4: Web-based admin dashboard to manage smartwatch clients, threshold calibrations & LINE Notify tokens.

p3.title: Automated Vehicle Access Control & Smart Parking Platform
p3.desc: Next-generation commercial parking management platform combining edge computer vision with instant web portal payments.
p3.f1: Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) with real-time video processing via Raspberry Pi 4 camera.
p3.f2: Admin dashboard for real-time parking barrier access control and live occupancy logs.
p3.f3: User web portal for automated parking fee calculation, ticketless entry, and QR invoices.
p3.f4: Integrated online payment gateway with fast webhook reconciliation and responsive UI.
